essence: Overlays a picked texture map (canvas / paper / grunge / organic, from BCC's built-in texture-preset library) over the source, compositing weave / grain / dirt onto the image. The go-to way to add analog surface, film-grunge, paper, or fabric texture on top of a clean layer. Amount = how strongly the texture is stamped on; the actual texture is chosen from a preset picker.
manifests_as: a woven / grungy texture pattern composited over the source, darkening and roughening it — probe-confirmed (Amount 0 clean, 40 subtle grain, 100 heavy weave; View=2 isolates the grey canvas texture map)

key_levers.name: Amount
key_levers.effect: MASTER — strength/opacity of the texture over the source. 0 = clean (off), ~20-40 = subtle grain/canvas, ~70-100 = heavy grunge stamp that darkens and roughens the image. Probe-confirmed.

key_levers.name: Complexity
key_levers.effect: detail/roughness of the texture pattern (extra octaves). Higher = denser, more chaotic, finer-grained weave. Probe-confirmed 0 vs 50.

key_levers.name: Texture
key_levers.effect: the texture-PRESET picker (a library of canvas/paper/grunge/organic maps). CUSTOM_VALUE UI control — NOT settable via numeric setValue; default is a woven canvas. Change via the effect UI or a saved preset.

key_levers.name: Randomize
key_levers.effect: seed/variation — shifts the texture pattern to a different random instance without changing its character.

key_levers.name: Texture Scale X / Y
key_levers.effect: size of the texture tiling (paired Scale Y = BCC_TEXTURES-1019). Small = fine tight grain, large = big coarse texture. Part of the Transform group (Position 1017, Rotate 1021).

key_levers.name: View
key_levers.effect: 1 = Output (texture composited over source), 2 = Texture (the texture map shown ISOLATED for setup). Probe-confirmed.

enums_to_verify.Texture preset (BCC_TEXTURES-1000, CUSTO: which canvas/paper/grunge/organic map — requires the effect UI picker; default = canvas weave
enums_to_verify.Edge Mode (BCC_TEXTURES-1030, 1-4): how the texture tiles/repeats at edges
enums_to_verify.Fit (BCC_TEXTURES-1028, 1-4): how the texture is fit to the frame

config_recipes.subtle film-grain / canvas: Amount 20-40, Complexity 0-10 — light surface texture, source still dominant
config_recipes.large coarse texture: Texture Scale 200-400, Amount 50-70 — big paper/wall feel
config_recipes.isolate to design the texture: View = 2 to see the texture map alone, then set back to 1

reasoning_hooks.change which texture (canvas vs paper vs: pick from the Texture preset library in the effect UI (CUSTOM, not numeric)

grounding: introspect card (108 leaf params, full SEMANTIC names + ranges — cards/BCC_TEXTURES.json) + 5-frame visual probe on a Fractal-Noise+Tint textured base (introspect/frames/ess_tex_*: amt0 clean, amt40 subtle grain, amt100 heavy weave, +Complexity denser, View=2 shows the grey canvas map) + model prior on BCC Textures. Confidence: high on Amount/Complexity/View; the Texture preset itself is a UI-only picker (noted).
_method: introspect + focused probe + synth (the essence-card pipeline)
